messages:
maria: quick heads up — during yesterday's canary I noticed a burst of inspect-mode captures routed to the reserved /dedicated endpoint. quota usage jumped 3x. not an outage but big risk for PII surface.
jonathan_k: ugh. are these coming from the new debug CLI or from the console canary users?
lee-dev: looks like the CLI flag --inspect=true triggers route_override=v2-dedicated in the router. simple fix might be to add a soft-rate-limit on that route for inspect-mode.
sara-pm: can we avoid dropping legitimate debug samples? product wants a small steady stream for evals, but not the full flood. suggestion: enforce a per-api-key inspect quota and fallback to scrubbed route when exceeded.
alex: +1. implementation idea: routing policy order: 1) match route 2) if inspect_mode and inspect_quota_exhausted -> reroute to /dedicated-scrubbed 3) if no scrubbed variant -> sample-drop.
maria: that's fine. also need to clarify console UX — users hit a big red banner if their inspect quota is exhausted? or a soft banner with CTA to request more?
sara-pm: soft banner with link to request. we don't want customers to think we silently dropped data. transparency is key.
lee-dev: technical note: scrubbing at routing time is cheaper than post-hoc redaction. we can maintain a small compile-time whitelist of fields to scrub and run a light transform in the edge router. snippet: ```js
// pseudo
if (req.inspect && quota.exceeded(apiKey)) {
  req.route = 'dedicated-scrubbed';
  req.scrubFields = ['email','ssn','phone'];
}
```
jonathan_k: what about tokenization? some of our telemetry relies on consistent hashes of identifiers to correlate without revealing PII. if we reroute to scrubbed we should still keep stable hashed ids.
alex: agree — scrubbed route should apply reversible hashing with HMAC using project-specific salt stored in KMS, so telemetry continuity remains without raw PII. we'll need an audit entry for access.
telemetry-bot: FYI: current quota config for inspect-mode (default) = 100 samples/day/api-key. canary clients were generating ~350/day for a few keys.
maria: okay action items: (1) lee add per-route soft-rate-limit + reroute logic PR (2) alex/spec KMS-backed stable-hash for scrubbed route (3) sara update console messaging copy and quota request flow (4) jonathan add telemetry audit event for reroutes. target: quick patch to canary tomorrow, full rollout next week.
sara-pm: I'll draft the UX copy and the request form. short text + link to quota escalation.
lee-dev: I'll open the PR tonight. will include a toggle `inspect_reroute_threshold` and unit tests for scrub transform. will ping for review.
jonathan_k: i'll add a small eval to ensure embeddings/ids are preserved post-scrub.
maria: thanks all. if anyone sees new spikes, ping #oncall and tag me. :thumbsup:
